extraction: Unmodified arXiv LaTeX source tarball for Eilers, Hogg, Rix & Ness 2019, ApJ 871, 120. Source of stream_eilers2019_MW_rotation_curve.tsv.
note: main.tex contains exactly ONE table environment (a deluxetable*), so the split-table failure mode does not apply. 38 numeric rows recovered spanning R = 5.27-24.82 kpc, consistent with the paper's stated 5-25 kpc coverage. The paper gives no explicit bin count in prose, so the range was asserted instead of a row count.
